purpose: Self-owned planned Activity Schedule name correction, without replacing Schedule or actual Session identity.

routine.return_type: TABLE(schedule_ref uuid, display_name text, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Presentation-only name change; never a new Session, Schedule or MaterialStateRef.
state_history.current_binding: Same planned Schedule identity; label change guarded by compare-and-swap.
state_history.chronology: Accepted current presentation label, with recorded execution untouched.
state_history.immutability_policy: No historical Session, Schedule or Actual records are mutated by the label capability.

lifecycle.retention: Schedule and linked Session history retained.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No deletion; a null label means an unnamed planned row.

obligations: True typed FK to item, Person and Life Area; no polymorphic owner or NativeAddress pollution.
Actor self scope, archived-target rejection, idempotency and CAS are verified in PostgreSQL.
No runtime raw table access; B04 scheduling is unaffected.
An archived target is rejected for new assignment, while previously assigned items remain readable and replayable.
